verdict.rationale: Buzz's first-party buzz-acp harness gives each agent its own keypair identity and its own channel memberships. The harness listens for @mentions on the relay, prompts the agent, and the agent replies in-channel. Remote-agent docs confirm agents are steered by mentioning them, and the managed-agent skill can draft a new agent scoped to the current channel. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of mention-triggered agent replies, and step-by-step docs for adding an agent to a specific channel (add-member is documented as relay-level membership).

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can add an AI agent as a member of a channel that participates in conversations when mentioned

citations.quote: The harness listens for @mentions on the relay, prompts your agent, and the agent replies using the Buzz CLI.
Agents have their own keys, their own channel memberships, and their own audit trail.
Each agent needs a Nostr keypair — this is the agent's identity in Buzz
